newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Freddie Mac, Fannie Mae.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Freddie Mac, Fannie Mae.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan said analyst Vivek Juneja started coverage of Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp (Freddie Mac) and Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae) with buy ratings.

-- In a report, Juneja said, "We believe Fannie Mae should be a core long-term holding because it is poised to maintain solid, consistent performance with 12-13 percent EPS growth and a more than 20 percent return on common equity."
-- In another report on Freddie Mac, the analyst said, "Freddie Mac's improving credit quality should lead its projected strong 15 percent annual EPS growth through 1998."
-- Freddie Mac ended Thursday at 104-3/4, and Fannie Mae ended at 39-3/4.
